item.description:
Location: Med/Caribbean
Description:

A Chief Steward position is available on a 70m motor yacht operating a private/charter program with a dual Med/Caribbean itinerary. The role involves managing clearances, crew onboarding, travel, invoicing, payroll, charter accounts, and reconciliations. Candidates should have at least 2 years of Purser experience on vessels over 70m, preferably with DeepBlue and Voly. A sociable, active personality and a commitment of over 2 years are required. The position offers an 8 weeks on / 8 weeks off rotation and a salary of 10,000 USD per month, starting around September 15th.



Apply to this job
